title: AI's Hidden Cost Crisis Is Gutting Startups Nobody Saw This Coming #Shorts
description:
The AI industry just slammed into a wall nobody modeled for. Token costs are spiraling so fast that startups are spending more on inference than they earn in revenue. This is the inside story of who survives the shakeout and who gets wiped out. The companies winning right now are doing the opposite 

#Shorts #FutureEdge #AI #Tech #AINews
